Nestlé India flags demand concerns, maintains long-term growth outlook

Nestlé India's management has indicated a slowdown in consumption, citing risks from the West Asia crisis and El Niño impacting near-term demand. Despite these challenges and inflationary macroeconomic headwinds, the company expressed confidence in its long-term growth prospects. The company stated its medium- to long-term growth story remains intact.
